items.name: Kapha Barley Mung Cabbage Meal
steps: Set aside 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) freshly boiled water for Kapha Barley Mung Cabbage Meal, reserving about 60 ml to correct the final consistency.
Cover the pearled barley with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 20 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.

Simmer the soaked barley and split mung until the grains begin to soften. Maintain steady low heat for 11–13 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Add the shredded cabbage and grated ginger, then cook uncovered as the broth reduces. Maintain moderate heat for 9–11 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the leaves wilt but still retain their color.

Season with cracked pepper and a light mustard-oil finish, keeping the meal loose rather than heavy. Leave the pan off the flame for 6 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Kapha Barley Mung Cabbage Meal 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

Soften the chayote dice in ghee and add the rice with hot water. Keep the pan over medium-low heat for 2–3 minutes after the final addition, folding from the bottom so the main pieces remain intact.

Scatter the peas over the grains as they approach tenderness and cover again. Maintain gentle medium heat for 8–10 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
For Tridoshic Rice Paneer Chayote, inspect the main component at minute 17; rotate the pot and add 30–60 ml hot water only if the base is tightening before it is tender.
Crush fennel over the pot, season, and fold the layers together gently. Work in 6 short pulses, pausing between them so the mixture stays cool and retains the intended texture.
Rest Tridoshic Rice Paneer Chayote 3 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Oat Masoor Carrot Bowl

ingredients.name: Carrots, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Bring 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water to a boil in a separate kettle and hold it hot, covered, so Tridoshic Oat Masoor Carrot Bowl never loses its simmer.

Cook the red lentils and carrot cubes until the roots become tender. Maintain gentle medium heat for 20–22 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a thin knife slides through the largest piece without resistance.
Stir in the rolled oats and coriander and simmer until the broth turns creamy. Aim for an even 3–4 mm thickness; repair cracks before the piece reaches the hot surface.
For Tridoshic Oat Masoor Carrot Bowl, inspect the main component at minute 17; rotate the pot and add 30–60 ml hot water only if the base is tightening before it is tender.
Season the bowl, remove it from direct heat, and add ghee before serving. Leave the pan off the flame for 3 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Oat Masoor Carrot Bowl 7 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Millet Tofu Zucchini

ingredients.name: Firm tofu, drained and cut into cubes

steps: Measure 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water for Tridoshic Millet Tofu Zucchini; bring it to a full boil, then keep it covered and hot for the additions below.
For Tridoshic Millet Tofu Zucchini, cover the proso millet with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 30 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.

Cook the soaked millet until nearly tender while keeping the grains moist. Maintain gentle medium heat for 11–13 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
Steam the zucchini and tofu over the millet with crushed fennel beneath the lid. Maintain a steady steam for 5–7 minutes and check until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
Fold in olive oil and salt, and serve the complete bowl warm. Leave the pan off the flame for 5 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Millet Tofu Zucchini 4 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Brown Rice Mung Beet Pot

ingredients.name: Beetroot, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Measure 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water for Tridoshic Brown Rice Mung Beet Pot; bring it to a full boil, then keep it covered and hot for the additions below.
For Tridoshic Brown Rice Mung Beet Pot, cover the brown rice with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 20 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.

Simmer the soaked brown rice and split mung until they begin to soften. Maintain medium-low heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Add the beet cubes and coriander and cook until the pot becomes ruby and tender. Maintain gentle medium heat for 19–21 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a thin knife slides through the largest piece without resistance.
Season the meal and fold in ghee while leaving the root pieces visible. Leave the pan off the flame for 6 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Brown Rice Mung Beet Pot 4 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Quinoa Mung Asparagus

ingredients.name: Quinoa, rinsed until free of foam
Asparagus, trimmed and cut into short pieces

steps: Set aside 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) freshly boiled water for Tridoshic Quinoa Mung Asparagus, reserving about 60 ml to correct the final consistency.

Cook the split mung until half tender before adding the rinsed quinoa. Maintain gentle medium heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Scatter in the asparagus pieces when the grains open and cover briefly. Maintain low heat for 7–9 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a knife tip enters the thickest stem with only slight resistance.
For Tridoshic Quinoa Mung Asparagus, inspect the main component at minute 17; rotate the pot and add 30–60 ml hot water only if the base is tightening before it is tender.
Season with olive oil and chopped dill after removing the meal from heat. Leave the pan off the flame for 6 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Quinoa Mung Asparagus 5 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Rice Chana Pumpkin Meal

ingredients.name: Pumpkin, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: Prepare 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) hot water before starting Tridoshic Rice Chana Pumpkin Meal; keep one small ladle in reserve in case the base tightens early.
Cover the chana dal with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 30 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.

Cook the soaked chana dal until almost tender before adding the rice. Maintain steady low heat for 12–14 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Set the pumpkin cubes over the grains with crushed fennel and simmer until soft. Maintain moderate heat for 18–20 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Fold in ghee and salt and adjust the complete meal to a moist consistency. Mix for 1 minute with the heat off, stopping when the seasonings are even and a pressed spoonful holds together without crumbling.
Rest Tridoshic Rice Chana Pumpkin Meal 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

items.name: Tridoshic Barley Pea Zucchini Stew
steps: Bring 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water to a boil in a separate kettle and hold it hot, covered, so Tridoshic Barley Pea Zucchini Stew never loses its simmer.
Cover the pearled barley with at least three times its volume of cool water and soak for 40 minutes; drain for 2 minutes before the first heated step.

Simmer the soaked barley until the grains are plump and almost tender. Maintain gentle medium heat for 10–12 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Add the zucchini and peas with ground coriander and cook until just soft. Maintain low heat for 19–21 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a spoon drawn across the base leaves a trail that closes slowly.

Season the stew, finish with olive oil, and preserve some broth for serving. Leave the pan off the flame for 5 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Barley Pea Zucchini Stew 4 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

ingredients.name: Amaranth grain, rinsed in a fine sieve

steps: Bring 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water to a boil in a separate kettle and hold it hot, covered, so Tridoshic Amaranth Mung Fennel never loses its simmer.

Cook the split mung until halfway soft and stir in the tiny amaranth grains. Maintain gentle medium heat for 12–14 minutes, stirring every 4 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.

Add the diced fennel bulb and crushed seeds and simmer until naturally sweet. Maintain low heat for 18–20 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
For Tridoshic Amaranth Mung Fennel, inspect the main component at minute 17; rotate the pot and add 30–60 ml hot water only if the base is tightening before it is tender.
Season the meal and fold in ghee before the amaranth sets too firmly. Leave the pan off the flame for 6 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Amaranth Mung Fennel 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.

ingredients.name: Carrots, peeled and cut into small cubes

steps: For Tridoshic Rice Mung Carrot Spinach, heat 1150 ml (about 4 3/4 cups) water until vigorously boiling, then lower it to a bare simmer beside the main pot for measured additions.

Cook the rice, split mung, and carrot cubes until all are nearly tender. Maintain gentle medium heat for 11–13 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until a grain pressed between two fingers has no chalky center.
Fold in the chopped spinach and coriander and simmer only until the leaves soften. Maintain low heat for 5–7 minutes, stirring every 3 minutes, until the leaves wilt but still retain their color.
For Tridoshic Rice Mung Carrot Spinach, inspect the main component at minute 17; rotate the pot and add 30–60 ml hot water only if the base is tightening before it is tender.
Season the colorful complete meal and melt ghee through it off the heat. Leave the pan off the flame for 3 minutes, then taste and correct the final balance before serving at the stated temperature.
Rest Tridoshic Rice Mung Carrot Spinach 6 minutes covered off the burner; check the final consistency and serve it warm without prolonged holding.
